front.title: Server-Led Algorithm Preference in the Secure Shell (SSH) Protocol

abstract.t: This document specifies an optional extension to Secure Shell (SSH) algorithm negotiation. A client and server can agree, through indicators in their SSH_MSG_KEXINIT messages, to use the server's algorithm preference order in place of the client's preference order. Agreement for one key exchange round does not carry forward to another round. Agreement governs bilateral algorithm negotiations in SSH_MSG_KEXINIT, as well as connection-wide extension mechanisms, including SSH_MSG_EXT_INFO delayed compression.
